verdict.stance: Constructive / Egypt State-Owned #2 Bank Riding Sovereign Upgrade (B3 Pos / B)
verdict.summary: Egypt's #2 state-owned bank (~20% sector assets, EGP 4.21tn) was upgraded by Moody's to B3 Positive in Oct-26 alongside the Egyptian sovereign. FY25 net profit climbed 24% to EGP 100.9bn (H126 EGP 57.47bn), lifting CET1 by 160bp to 10.7% with ~260% FC LCR and <3% NPLs, though sovereign bond concentration remains high.

positives: Moody's upgraded to B3 Positive (Oct-26) following Egypt sovereign upgrade; Fitch & S&P B Stable.
Strong capital build: CET1 rose +160bp to 10.7% on EGP 100.9bn FY25 profit (+24% YoY) and EGP 57.47bn H126 profit.
Massive ~20% Egyptian system deposit franchise (EGP 2.935tn) and ~260% FC liquidity coverage ratio.
negatives: Heavy direct Egyptian sovereign securities exposure (S&P RAC ratio 4.1% in 2025).
NIM compression risk as CBE cuts policy rates through 2026-27.
State policy lending mandate and historical high-yield certificate funding costs.
